Neiman Marcus Cake II

Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 45 mins
Total Time: 1 hr
Servings: 12
Yield: 1 9x13-inch cake

Ingredients
1 (18.25 ounce) package yellow cake mix
1/2 cup butter, melted
4 large eggs, divided
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened
1 (16 ounce) package confectioners' sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Directions
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
2. Mix cake mix, melted butter, and 2 eggs in a large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Pat the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan.
3. Beat cream cheese in a bowl until smooth. Add remaining 2 eggs, confectioners' sugar, and vanilla; beat until smooth. Pour over the cake layer.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.
